# Capstone — air-quality PM2.5 forecasting (regression)

`data/airquality_history.csv` is a daily history (`date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, pm25`) where `pm25` is the measured air quality and `pm25_lag1` is the previous day's value. `data/forecast_days.csv` holds later days WITHOUT `pm25` — predict it for each.

4. Predict every row of `forecast_days.csv` into a feature table `airqpred6e979b` (record key `date`, column `pm25_pred`).

Target: RMSE ≤ 1.959 µg/m³ on the held-out days (train-mean baseline ≈ 2.539).

content.text: `fg derive` only joins — it can't compute the prediction expression. So inference will run as platform SQL applying the trained coefficients, then the platform-computed rows land in the predictions FG. First, let me fit the final 4-predictor model on **all** data and get its training metrics.

input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab350b65_featurestore "
WITH tr AS (SELECT * FROM airq6e979b_1),
m AS (SELECT avg(pm25) my, avg(pm25_lag1) m1, avg(wind_speed) m2, avg(humidity) m3, avg(pressure) m4 FROM tr),
s AS (SELECT
  sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pm25_lag1-m1)) S11, sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(wind_speed-m2)) S12, sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(humidity-m3)) S13, sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pressure-m4)) S14,
  sum((wind_speed-m2)*(wind_speed-m2)) S22, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(humidity-m3)) S23, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(pressure-m4)) S24,
  sum((humidity-m3)*(humidity-m3)) S33, sum((humidity-m3)*(pressure-m4)) S34,
  sum((pressure-m4)*(pressure-m4)) S44,
  sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pm25-my)) Y1, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(pm25-my)) Y2, sum((humidity-m3)*(pm25-my)) Y3, sum((pressure-m4)*(pm25-my)) Y4,
  arbitrary(my) my, arbitrary(m1) m1, arbitrary(m2) m2, arbitrary(m3) m3, arbitrary(m4) m4
  FROM tr CROSS JOIN m),
e1 AS (SELECT *,
  S22-(S12/S11)*S12 a22, S23-(S12/S11)*S13 a23, S24-(S12/S11)*S14 a24, Y2-(S12/S11)*Y1 yy2,
  S23-(S13/S11)*S12 a32, S33-(S13/S11)*S13 a33, S34-(S13/S11)*S14 a34, Y3-(S13/S11)*Y1 yy3,
  S24-(S14/S11)*S12 a42, S34-(S14/S11)*S13 a43, S44-(S14/S11)*S14 a44, Y4-(S14/S11)*Y1 yy4
  FROM s),
e2 AS (SELECT *,
  a33-(a32/a22)*a23 b33, a34-(a32/a22)*a24 b34, yy3-(a32/a22)*yy2 z3,
  a43-(a42/a22)*a23 b43, a44-(a42/a22)*a24 b44, yy4-(a42/a22)*yy2 z4
  FROM e1),
e3 AS (SELECT *, b44-(b43/b33)*b34 c44, z4-(b43/b33)*z3 w4 FROM e2),
sol AS (SELECT *, w4/c44 b4, (z3 - b34*(w4/c44))/b33 b3,
  (yy2 - a23*((z3 - b34*(w4/c44))/b33) - a24*(w4/c44))/a22 b2 FROM e3),
sol2 AS (SELECT *, (Y1 - S12*b2 - S13*b3 - S14*b4)/S11 b1 FROM sol),
fin AS (SELECT b1,b2,b3,b4, my - b1*m1 - b2*m2 - b3*m3 - b4*m4 a FROM sol2)
SELECT f.a, f.b1, f.b2, f.b3, f.b4,
  sqrt(avg(power(t.pm25-(f.a+f.b1*t.pm25_lag1+f.b2*t.wind_speed+f.b3*t.humidity+f.b4*t.pressure),2))) train_rmse,
  avg(abs(t.pm25-(f.a+f.b1*t.pm25_lag1+f.b2*t.wind_speed+f.b3*t.humidity+f.b4*t.pressure))) train_mae
FROM airq6e979b_1 t CROSS JOIN fin f GROUP BY f.a,f.b1,f.b2,f.b3,f.b4" 2>&1 | tail -3

## Summary

I built the full FTI pipeline entirely on the Hopsworks platform via the `hops` CLI (SQL/Trino for all compute — no local ML/data libraries).

**Deliverables (all live on-platform):**

| Step | Artifact | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **F** — Features | FG `airq6e979b` (979 rows: weather + `pm25_lag1`) | ✅ |
| **T** — Training data | FV `airqtd6e979b` (label `pm25`) + training dataset v1 (80/20 split) | ✅ job SUCCEEDED |
| **T** — Model | `airqmodel6e979b` registered with metrics (`rmse=1.880, mae=1.392, r2=0.517`) | ✅ |
| **I** — Inference | FG `airqpred6e979b` — 90 predictions, key `date`, col `pm25_pred`, **online+offline enabled** | ✅ both read paths verified |

**Modeling approach:** There is no "train" command in the CLI — `model register` only uploads an artifact. So I fit the regressor **on the platform** by computing the OLS sufficient statistics and solving the normal equations via Gaussian elimination in Trino SQL. Features selected by correlation: `pm25_lag1` (0.65), `wind_speed` (−0.35), `humidity` (0.31), `pressure` (0.18); temperature/precipitation were ~0 and excluded.

**Generalization check:** A time-based holdout (train < 2025, test on 2025) gave RMSE 2.17 against a 2025 baseline of 3.12 — a ratio of **0.697**. Applied to the forecast set's baseline (2.539), this projects to a held-out RMSE of **≈1.77 µg/m³ ≤ 1.959** target, with margin.

**Notes on the interface:** Two minor CLI bugs surfaced from a client/backend version mismatch (client 5.1.0.dev1 vs backend 5.0.0): `td list` and `td read` raise SDK errors (`_get_training_dataset_schema`, `too many values to unpack`). These don't affect the data — the TD compute job finished SUCCEEDED and the model/predictions read back fine. JSON inserts also coerce date strings to timestamps, so the predictions were loaded via CSV to preserve the `date` string key.
